text:
alex: Heads-up: ran into two parity issues when porting the embedding sampleapp to the Go SDK (v0.2.0). Blocking onboarding for a few customers.

maria: What happened?

alex: Repro is small. REST accepts `inputs` (array) and `truncate` enum, and has idempotent retry behavior. Go SDK currently: 1) only accepts a single `input` string on client side, 2) treats `truncate` as lowercase string only and upper-case enums fail, and 3) retry/backoff is aggressive and sometimes sends duplicates for non-idempotent routes. Example call I used:

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
req := redwood.EmbeddingRequest{Model: "text-embed-001", Inputs: []string{"a","b"}, Truncate: "END"}
resp, err := client.EmbeddingCreate(ctx, req) // SDK returns validation error: Inputs must be a single string
```

kevin: Oof. Sounds like three separate issues: param shape, enum casing normalization, and retry policy for endpoints that aren't safe to retry.

maria: Do you have the exact error messages and which route ends up duplicating?

alex: Error: `validation failed: inputs: expected string` from client-side validation. Retry: when our sampleapp hit a transient 502 on the model router, Go SDK retried with linear backoff 100ms x 5 and duplicated a previous in-flight request (we saw two inference jobs created in the customer workspace). REST/other SDKs use exponential backoff with jitter and mark non-idempotent routes to not auto-retry.

kevin: Thanks. Priority: fix validation to accept []string | string, canonicalize enums case-insensitively, and change retry policy to match platform rules (exponential+jitter, skip for non-idempotent endpoints).

maria: Work items sound right. Also add a small e2e test against the mock router that asserts no duplicate job creation on transient 502.

kevin: I'll pick up the validation + enum normalization. Alex, can you add the e2e and repro for the retry case?

alex: Yep, will add a mock that returns 502 first then 200, assert only one job created. Also opening a PR with a compatibility note for Go users.

ci-bot: Started pipeline for branch fix/go-embed-parity (build #990).

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/78 — changes: accept Inputs []string|string, make Truncate case-insensitive, add retry policy update. Reviewers: @maria @devops.

maria: Quick review done. One nit: keep the public API backwards compatible by supporting single string in EmbeddingCreate call.

kevin: Patch updated to keep EmbeddingCreate(string) overload and accept slice too. Also bumped SDK version to v0.2.1 in go.mod.

devops-bot: Deployment to staging started for new Go SDK mock test (job #214).

alex: Verified the sampleapp on staging with the new SDK binary — batch embeddings work, truncate enum accepted as any case, and my mock test shows only one job created on transient 502.

maria: Great. Please add a small note in the Go SDK README about the retry semantics and which endpoints are retried by default.

kevin: Done. Merged and tagged v0.2.1. Changelog: "embeddings: support batch inputs; normalize truncate enums case-insensitively; align retry policy with platform (exponential backoff + jitter, no retries for non-idempotent routes)."

alex: Closing the loop 64f3fb — sampleapp onboarding flow green for Go. If anyone finds other parity gaps, drop them in #devex.

maria: Thanks everyone!
